intent: Review the compatible module types for a transceiver bay type.
actions: Start signed in as an administrator at a 1280×720 desktop viewport, with the filtered Module Types catalog showing a large collection of transceiver types and their manufacturers.
Follow Module Bay Types in the Devices navigation and open the corresponding transceiver bay type; wait for the compatible collection to load.
Review the compatible module types and the available ordering and browsing controls.
Scroll down to inspect the lower bay information sections.
Return to the beginning of the compatible collection.
